name: video-convert
description: Bidirectional video format conversion (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, m4v, gif)
author: uniconv

options.name: --fps
options.description: Output frames per second (0 = keep original; default 10 for GIF)

options.name: --width
options.description: Output width in pixels (height auto-scaled to preserve aspect ratio)

options.name: --height
options.description: Output height in pixels (width auto-scaled to preserve aspect ratio)

options.name: --loop
options.description: Number of loops for GIF (0 = infinite)

dependencies.name: libavformat-dev
dependencies.install_hint: brew install ffmpeg (macOS) or apt install libavformat-dev (Linux)

dependencies.name: libavcodec-dev
dependencies.install_hint: brew install ffmpeg (macOS) or apt install libavcodec-dev (Linux)

dependencies.name: libavutil-dev
dependencies.install_hint: brew install ffmpeg (macOS) or apt install libavutil-dev (Linux)

dependencies.name: libswscale-dev
dependencies.install_hint: brew install ffmpeg (macOS) or apt install libswscale-dev (Linux)

dependencies.name: libavfilter-dev
dependencies.install_hint: brew install ffmpeg (macOS) or apt install libavfilter-dev (Linux)
